result.title: Business registration with a tax number
result.steps: Fees and a name check need no personal details: rules_lookup topic business_fees, topic name_check. result.title: Trading permit

result.title: Primary school place
result.steps: Places are free and go by catchment first, then distance, then space: rules_lookup topic eligibility; topic schools for the zone. Verify the parent; record consent (consent_record, scope school_application); application_submit with on_behalf_of the child and fields_json {"preferred_school_id":...} (two-step). If an officer must confirm an offer, say so and never say refused.

result.title: Kenyan passport renewal
result.steps:
Fees and the renewal rules need no personal details: rules_lookup topic fees, topic renewal_rules. A returning caller: rules_lookup topic my_application gives their application and the fee still owed (owed_kes, the amount for payment_request). To renew: verify the caller, rules_lookup topic renewal, application_submit (two-step), payment_request and payment_confirm, appointment_book (biometrics), delivery_book (home or collect). Say each decision with its reason and the review route.
Once the fee is paid and biometrics are booked, delivery_book books home delivery or collection at the Konza Passport Desk (method collect).
Delivery is handed only to the holder in person, with ID and a one-time code. Biometrics (PP-03): a working day (Monday to Friday, not a public holiday) within the next 10 working days, morning or afternoon; appointment_book checks the day.

result.reason_en: Application SPS-4F2A9C1D: granted; fee not paid yet (KES 7550 owed); biometrics not booked; no delivery or collection booked.
A passport can be renewed within 12 months of its expiry date, after it has expired, or at any time if it is full or damaged. Otherwise the number of pages left does not matter.
A business name is KES 950, a private limited company KES 10,500, each with a tax number at no extra cost; a trading permit is KES 5,000 a year.
The minimum contribution is KES 300 a month; cover is active once this month's contribution has cleared.
Schools in zone 3, with places left. Places go to children in the zone first; for a school outside the zone or one that is full, an officer confirms an offer, and any decision can be reviewed.
Public primary places are free for children aged 5 to 13.
Fees by booklet: 34 pages KES 7,550, 50 pages KES 9,550, 66 pages KES 12,050.
Renewal is open now for this passport (it expires on 2027-03-05): it expires within 12 months.
